items.title: 14” MacBook Pro
items.description: I'm an Apple fanboy and I love this laptop. It's the perfect size and it's super powerful. Battery life is great and it stays cool even when I'm running a million things at once.

items.title: Vortex Pok3r 60% Keyboard
items.description: I love this keyboard so much I have two of them. At first I was worried about the lack of buttons and the small size, but with layers and mappings I can do everything at lightning speed.

items.title: Razer DeathAdder v2 Gaming Mouse
items.description: I've mapped the buttons to do things like switch spaces, open Mission Control, and switch between apps. If you haven't tried a gaming mouse for development, you're missing out.

items.title: Visual Studio Code
items.description: I've used Sublime Text, PHPStorm, Vim, and everything in between. Visual Studio Code is my favorite. It's fast, has a ton of great plugins, and is super customizable.

items.title: iTerm2
items.description: A hotkey to quickly toggle your terminal is a game changer.

items.title: Kaleidoscope
items.description: Fantastic diff tool that easily integrates with Git.

items.title: Bruno
items.description: A relatively new tool that I've been using for a bit. It's a replacement for Postman and I'm loving it.

items.title: 1Password
items.description: I can't imagine my life without 1Password. It's a must-have.

items.title: Arc from The Browser Company
items.description: Honestly, I don't know what I'd do without Arc. It's a fantastic browser that's got a ton of great features.

items.title: Alfred
items.description: I've been using Alfred for years. I have so many custom workflows and actions that make my life so much easier.

items.title: BetterTouchTool
items.description: Another app that without it, I'd be lost.

items.title: Fantastical
items.description: Great calendar app that I use on all my devices. Adding events via natural language is such a time saver.

items.title: Notion
items.description: I use Notion for everything. Basically my second brain.
